name: tz_convert
description: Time zones from the IANA database: convert a date-time from one zone to several, show a zone's UTC offset, abbreviation and DST state at a moment, or list a year's daylight-saving transitions. Local times that fall in a DST gap or happen twice are flagged, not silently shifted. Reports the tzdata version used.

datetime.description: ISO 8601; local to from_zone or zone unless it carries an offset or Z

fold.description: For a repeated local time: 0 the first, 1 the second

catalog.source: Python zoneinfo over the system's IANA tz database
